description: getHostsForDomain: List all host/glue records associated with a domain. Requires authentication. Returns each host name and its IP addresses.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name whose host records to list, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getHostsForDomain
